editorial:
Imagine a tiny peanut and a giant elephant getting into a huge fight over a snack. That is exactly what you get with Sidney the Elephant in this funny short. It has that classic 1960s cartoon feel where everything is bright, bouncy, and a little bit chaotic. You will love how Sidney tries to be graceful but ends up causing a mess everywhere he goes. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, making it the kind of thing you can put on when you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some physical comedy.

The pacing is super fast, so you never get bored. The best part is the way the animation handles the scale between the big elephant and the small peanut. While it is a short film, it packs a lot of jokes into a few minutes. If you are into vintage animation, you should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the colors pop. You can also try renting it on Apple TV if you want a quick laugh. It is a great pick for families or anyone who misses the golden age of cartoons.
endingExplained: The chaos peaks when Sidney finally thinks he has won the battle for the peanut. Just as he is about to eat it, a series of clumsy accidents happen that send the peanut flying high into the air. Instead of getting his prize, Sidney ends up accidentally sitting on it, crushing it completely. He is left looking sad and confused while the screen fades out, showing that his greed was his own downfall.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic slapstick cartoons
